name: Didgeridoo wobble drone
desc: A slower, ceremonial didgeridoo bass: a long sustained e2 drone with a wide slow filter wobble (yidaki breath), overblown vocal-call toots that alternate <b3 e4 g4> and answer through dub delay, opposite-phase pan drift, and a lastOf/iter evolution over long spans. More meditative and vocalized than the tongued sibling. add-note transposable off E.
